$comment: The committed registry of the succession-wizard screens (JRNY-05, plan 12-03). A step is DATA, never code. Every record declares reset case-alpha-no-output: plan 12-06 leaves an output_json behind on this same case, and $caseId.tsx routes a case that has one to the results view instead of the wizard, so without the reset run two would screenshot a different screen than run one. Every url carries ?step= alone, which readInitialWizardState() in WizardContainer.tsx reads once at mount; $caseId.tsx declares no validateSearch, so the router does not strip it. The wizard-review rubric pins predicted-scenario to I2 with text_equals -- the code the release binary prints for engine/examples/cases/02-married-3lc.json, which seed.sql:15 states is a verbatim copy of this case's input_json. Before plan 12-01 that badge read I1, computed by a second classifier in ReviewStep.tsx. If a duplicate classifier is ever reintroduced this assertion goes red instead of a reference silently freezing a wrong legal answer. BLOCKED, NOT REGISTERED: wizard-will. Its rubric file exists but no step names it and no reference was approved. ?hasWill=1 sets WizardContainer's hasWill boolean but never constructs the will object that EstateStep's handleSuccessionChange constructs, and the seeded case has will: null, so WillStep.tsx:28 returns an empty <div data-testid="will-step" /> and waitForSelector times out on a zero-size element. See the 12-03 summary.
